description: Bâtiments is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Représentation géométrique et conventionnelle des toits des bâtiments en plan 2.5D. C'est-à-dire que les éléments sont montrés en planimétrie 2D en plus d' informations altimétriques représentées par des cotes d'élévation ponctuelles. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Bâtiment, SIRR, Toit, Élévation. It offers 2 resource(s) in GPKG, SHP. The portal shows 2025-02-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
